tools.name: get_esim_portugal_plans
tools.description: The Portugal Internet eSIM for travellers to Portugal (mainland, Madeira, Azores): truly unlimited data, priced by trip length. Returns the price tiers and what the eSIM includes. quote_esim_portugal gives the exact price for given dates.

tools.name: quote_esim_portugal
tools.description: The live price of the Portugal eSIM for the traveller's dates, and a booking link with those dates already chosen. It does not pay or place an order: the traveller opens the link, continues to checkout, enters their details and pays. Dates are the first and last day the traveller needs data, inclusive (a trip from 2 to 9 November is 8 days). One eSIM per booking.

start_date.description: First day the eSIM is needed, YYYY-MM-DD. Today or later.

end_date.description: Last day the eSIM is needed, YYYY-MM-DD.
